newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police detain two suspected ETA members.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police detain two suspected ETA members.

text.p: Spanish police detained two suspected members of the Basque separatist group ETA overnight, the Interior Ministry said on Wednesday.

A ministry statement identified the two as Maria Aranzazu Barrenechea, 33 and Ignacio Azurmendi Jauregui, 28. They were held in Spain's northern Basque region on suspicion of supporting ETA's Donosti (San Sebastian) command group.
Barrenechea is suspected of links with ETA leaders who had fled to France, the ministry said.
The statement said Barrenechea is also suspected of ties to the ETA command cell in the Navarra region.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed some 800 people in a campaign of bombings, shootings and kidnappings since 1968 to press demands for independence.
